tests.fixtures: Synthetic temporary PNG/MachO/plist/receipts only; no app, simulator, browser, network or actual native evidence operated.

rationale: Stream receipts retain only complete decoded-body SHA/bytes/times and target digest/category; no key-bearing bundle body, URL/query/header/file retention.
Receipts explicitly do not authenticate client or prove execution; separate current-session load-set and binary/source/module identity review required; lazy entry-only coverage rejected.
Measured PNG pixels and native DPR/screen/window points must agree on both axes. Portrait trace cannot become landscape fit.
Fit keeps raw_pixel_scale distinct from output_pixels_per_logical_point, preserves fullPNG with no crop, minimum logical/output geometry and all source/metadata/build/label/review/fit digests.
Future actual master/frame/caption/legibility and playback gates remain independent and require root review before adoption.
current_native_owner_observation: Owner reports a real landscape startup PNG but a blocking render error; it remains diagnostic, never operational footage. Logical geometry receipt and captured-load identity still require real verification.
